title: Aurelia — Personal finance
imageAlt: Two Aurelia phone screens showing balances and spending in a dark teal interface
description: A mobile budgeting concept for people who want to see what is available after bills and savings commitments.
challenge: A bank balance can look reassuring even when rent and other recurring payments are still due. The design separates available spending from money already set aside.

workflow.title: Review this month
workflow.detail: See the current balance alongside scheduled bills and the amount left to spend.

workflow.title: Correct a category
workflow.detail: Open an unfamiliar transaction, adjust its category, and see the revised budget immediately.

workflow.title: Set money aside
workflow.detail: Create a savings goal and check its progress without leaving the overview.

validation: Test whether users can explain the difference between current balance and available spending before making a purchase.

title: Maison Vale — Architecture studio
imageAlt: Maison Vale architecture website featuring an editorial interior photograph
description: An architecture studio website that helps prospective residential clients browse past work and make an informed inquiry.
challenge: Visitors need enough detail about a studio’s work to decide whether it fits their project, often before they know how to describe what they want.

workflow.title: Browse by project type
workflow.detail: Explore renovations and new builds through a photo-led index.

workflow.title: Open a project
workflow.detail: Read the brief, review material choices, and see how the layout responds to the site.

workflow.title: Share a brief
workflow.detail: Send the studio a location, project type, and approximate timeline.

validation: Ask prospective clients to find a relevant project and identify what to include in an inquiry.

title: PocketStock — Inventory operations
imageAlt: PocketStock inventory workspace showing a stock table, warehouse columns, and low-stock indicators
description: A desktop inventory workspace for small distributors receiving shipments and tracking stock across warehouses.
challenge: A stock count becomes hard to reconcile when units are reserved, damaged, or sitting at another warehouse.

workflow.title: Receive a shipment
workflow.detail: Match incoming quantities to a purchase order and flag damaged or missing units.

workflow.title: Check availability
workflow.detail: Compare on-hand and reserved quantities by location before committing units to an order.

workflow.title: Review low stock
workflow.detail: Filter items below reorder thresholds and inspect their movement history.

validation: Run a trial with a partial receipt and a stock discrepancy to see whether staff can reconcile both.

title: Parcelio — Dispatch coordination
imageAlt: Parcelio dispatch map with a violet route and a delivery stop list
description: A browser-based dispatch workspace for assigning deliveries and adjusting routes when plans change.
challenge: A dispatcher needs to see what changed and who is affected when a driver falls behind or a stop moves outside its delivery window.

workflow.title: Assign stops
workflow.detail: Group stops by area and check their time windows before handing a route to a driver.

workflow.title: Handle a delay
workflow.detail: Open a flagged stop, compare nearby routes, and review the impact before reassigning it.

workflow.title: Close a delivery
workflow.detail: Record the delivery status and keep the stop history available for follow-up.

validation: Use a delayed-route scenario to test how quickly dispatchers can identify the affected stops and make a handoff.

title: Kinfolk Shop — Ceramics storefront
imageAlt: Kinfolk Shop storefront with hand-finished ceramic products and prices
description: An online storefront for small-batch ceramics, with product photography and clear delivery information.
challenge: Buying handmade ceramics online requires confidence about size, finish, and whether a limited run can arrive on time.

workflow.title: Browse the collection
workflow.detail: Explore products by use and see availability beside each item.

workflow.title: Compare finishes
workflow.detail: Check glaze photographs, dimensions, and care guidance on the product page.

workflow.title: Review delivery
workflow.detail: See packaging details, delivery estimates, and return terms before checkout.

validation: Test whether a gift shopper can compare two pieces and determine which will arrive before a given date.

title: Fieldnote — Site inspections
imageAlt: Fieldnote tablet interface showing a site photo and an inspection checklist
description: A tablet-first inspection workflow for site supervisors recording issues and assigning follow-up work.
challenge: Notes and photographs collected on-site can lose their context when the supervisor turns them into a report at the end of a shift.

workflow.title: Open the checklist
workflow.detail: Choose a site and inspection area, then review the items required for that visit.

workflow.title: Record a defect
workflow.detail: Attach a photo to an individual item with its location and required follow-up.

workflow.title: Hand off follow-up
workflow.detail: Review outstanding items and assign each action before sharing the report.

validation: Test a walkthrough with intermittent connectivity, including a photo capture and later handoff.

title: Relay Desk — Customer support inbox
imageAlt: Relay Desk ticket queue, customer conversation, and suggested reply panel
description: An AI-assisted inbox for support teams that need to answer recurring questions while keeping agents in control of every reply.
challenge: Agents often switch between a conversation and several policy documents to confirm what they can offer a customer. The draft needs to show which policy it used and when the evidence is incomplete.

workflow.title: Identify the issue
workflow.detail: Group incoming tickets by topic and flag conversations that include a deadline or an unresolved escalation.

workflow.title: Review a draft
workflow.detail: Open the cited policy beside the suggested reply and edit the wording before sending.

workflow.title: Escalate exceptions
workflow.detail: Assign cases with unclear policies to a supervisor and include the context already gathered.

validation: Give agents a ticket where two policy versions disagree and check whether they can spot and resolve the conflict before sending a reply.

title: Access Lab — Accessibility review
imageAlt: Access Lab showing a website preview beside a list of accessibility findings
description: A review workspace for design and engineering teams checking accessibility before a release.
challenge: An audit finding can be difficult to reproduce if the report leaves out the page state, the interaction, or the browser conditions.

workflow.title: Capture a finding
workflow.detail: Record the page, browser, viewport, and steps that reproduce a keyboard or contrast issue.

workflow.title: Assign a fix
workflow.detail: Connect the finding to an owner and add the expected behavior, including where keyboard focus should land.

workflow.title: Retest the interaction
workflow.detail: Repeat the recorded steps and document the result, including whether new issues appeared.

validation: Ask a developer to reproduce a focus issue from the report, then check whether another reviewer can confirm the fix from the same steps.

title: Meterline — Energy analytics
imageAlt: Meterline dashboard with energy consumption charts and a facility comparison table
description: An energy monitoring dashboard for facility managers comparing electricity use across sites and operating schedules.
challenge: A spike can indicate equipment running after hours, a planned shift, or missing meter readings. The dashboard needs to show the context before a manager investigates.

workflow.title: Compare sites
workflow.detail: Review usage against each site’s own baseline and compare equivalent operating hours.

workflow.title: Investigate a spike
workflow.detail: Open the interval readings and check them against operating schedules and meter availability.

workflow.title: Share the evidence
workflow.detail: Export the relevant chart and attach notes about scheduled work or a suspected equipment issue.

validation: Give a manager a chart with one overnight spike and one missing reading to see if both are identified correctly.
